events.title: Barn Rush Demo 0.1.9: Big Update for Next Fest
events.summary: Thanks to everyone who has played the demo so far! This is a big one: rebalanced cards, a fresh look for the farm menus and run results, farm colours, smoother play on Steam Deck, and a pile of fixes from your feedback. Balance The Hay Wheel now has 1 gold, 2 silver and 1 wooden slice. Gold chests are rarer (2.5%), and Gold Find gives a bit more per level (+1.25%). The snail moves a little faster. events.title: Demo update 0.1.7: Performance Improvements
events.summary: Smoother on Steam Deck and slower PCs. The round-end receipt, upgrade screen, Hay Wheel and Pause no longer drop frames. No gameplay changes. Thanks to everyone playing!

events.title: Free Barn Rush demo is out now!
events.summary: Hi everyone, Joe here. The free demo of Barn Rush is out now on Steam! Grab food, haul a wobbly stack back to the barn, and beat the clock. Barn Rush is a time-attack roguelite about farm animals in fifteen-second rounds.
